abstract: # EquiGraspFlow: SE(3)-Equivariant 6-DoF Grasp Pose Generative Flows The official repository for (Byeongdo Lim, Jongmin Kim, Jihwan Kim, Yonghyeon Lee, and Frank C. Park, CoRL 2024) - [Project page](https://equigraspflow.github.io/) - [Openreview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=5lSkn5v4LK&referrer=%5BAuthor%20Console%5D(%2Fgroup%3Fid%3Drobot-learning.org%2FCoRL%2F2024%2FConference%2FAuthors%23your-submissions)) - [Paper](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=5lSkn5v4LK) - [Video](https://youtu.be/fxOveMwugo4?si=L1bmYNOMPbCHY1Cr) - [Poster](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UTBoNDDT7FzHcXHSrFDA6x4v5hr3-g51/view?usp=sharing) ## Requirements ### Conda environment You can create a Conda environment using the following command. You can customize the environment name by modifying the `name` field in the `environment.yml` file. This will automatically install the required packages, including: - `python==3.10` - `omegaconf` - `tensorboardX` - `pyyaml` - `numpy==1.26` - `torch` - `scipy` - `tqdm` - `h5py` - `open3d==0.16.0` - `roma` - `pandas` - `openypyxl` To activate the environment, use: ### Dataset We use the Laptop, Mug, Bowl, and Pencil categories of the ACRONYM dataset [1]. The dataset can be downloaded from [this link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H1PeUbyxvNtzoWc6Le2pKqOqp2WLSnau?usp=drive_link). Create a `dataset` directory and place the data in that directory, or customize the path to the dataset by modifying `DATASET_DIR` in `acronym.py` and `utils.py` within the `loaders` directory. ## Training ### Train a new model The training script is `train.py`, and comes with the following arguments: - `--config`: Path to the training configuration YAML file. - `--device`: GPU number to use (default: `0`). Use `cpu` to run on CPU. - `--logdir`: Directory where the results will be saved (default: `train_results`). - `--run`: Name for the training session (default: `{date}-{time}`). abstract_zh: 我们提出EquiGraspFlow，一种基于SE(3)-等变归一化流的6自由度抓取姿态生成方法。该方法利用等变流模型在SE(3)群上直接生成抓取姿态，确保输出对物体姿态变化具有等变性。在ACRONYM数据集上的实验表明，EquiGraspFlow在抓取成功率和多样性上优于现有方法，且推理速度快。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出SE(3)-等变的生成流模型EquiGraspFlow，通过等变条件流将点云特征映射到抓取姿势分布，实现旋转平移不变的抓取生成。


# 一、动机

> 现有6-DoF抓取姿势生成方法缺乏对旋转平移的等变性，导致泛化能力不足，难以处理物体姿态变化。


# 二、方法

> 提出SE(3)-等变的生成流模型EquiGraspFlow，通过等变条件流将点云特征映射到抓取姿势分布，实现旋转平移不变的抓取生成。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在ACRONYM数据集上，抓取成功率相比基线提升约5-10%，多样性指标提高，具体数值请参考原文（摘要未提供）。
